postgame.what_decided_it: Cincinnati were cleaner and more efficient in Madrid, 34-17. Burrow went 24/29 for 271 and three scores, the Bengals turned it over zero times and went 6-10 on third down at 7.1 yards a play.
standouts: .Ja'Marr Chase: 10 rec, 155 yds, 1 TD. He was the game's engine and the reason 29 attempts was enough.
Joe Burrow: 24/29, 271 yds, 3 TD, 0 INT. Nine drives, three red zone trips from four, no waste.
Tee Higgins: 5 rec, 32 yds, 2 TD. Small yardage night, two scores, which is the point of having him.
postgame.division_meaning: Bengals are 7-2 with a W5 streak and a plus-85 differential, clear of Pittsburgh at 6-3, Cleveland 6-4 and Baltimore 4-6 on an L5 slide. The North runs through Cincinnati now.
postgame.the_take: Atlanta ran for 157 at 6.5 a carry and Bijan hit 100, and it still was not close. That is the tell: this Bengals team can concede the run and win on the margins, 12 ATL penalties for 88 yards included.

lines: Week 18 has Bears at Vikings, both 7-2, kickoff Sun, 10 Jan, time not set yet. Division decider shape before anyone names a time.
Steelers at Ravens in Week 18, 6-3 against 4-6, also no confirmed kick time. Baltimore are on an L5 run and need it more.
Lions at Packers at Lambeau, 7-2 versus 6-4, time not set yet. Second helping after their Week 17 listing in Chicago.
Buffalo are 8-1 and San Francisco 8-1, the two best records on the board. SF draw Arizona, Buffalo get the 2-8 Jets.
